MVP.standardization: Within-season candidate-pool z scores except uncentered availability and MVP rank curve terms.
MVP.standings: Conference and league rank by final regular-season win percentage; normalized to 0-1; ties averaged; playoff seed and play-in results excluded
MVP.validation_warning: 2016-2026 results previously inspected; retrospective comparison, not a fresh untouched test.
MVP.selection: User-requested qualified PPG and WS/48 top-five penalties; existing model inputs and settings retained.
MVP.availability: d=max(0,ceil(0.85*S)-G), r=ln(2)/(0.10*S); negative fitted weight * (expm1(r*d)-r*d)/r. No linear component; gentler for small deficits and exponential for large deficits.
MVP.expectations: Preseason win-total market line scaled to actual team games / planned preseason schedule; actual wins minus scaled expected wins. Coefficient constrained nonnegative. Pre-2003 training seasons are neutral; aggregate-team rows use season-pool median inputs.
MVP.rank_penalties: PPG marginal penalty doubles each 5% of qualified field below fifth; WS48 remains 10%. Both exponential, zero through fifth; unqualified players excluded.
MVP.retrospective_warning: Rules revised after examining 2016–17 ROY and 2022–23 MVP. Historical fits use prior seasons, but these are retrospective comparisons; display now covers 2000–01 to 2025–26.
